readout: Archived standardized L2 logistic model, weighted partition rows and maximum partition probability; monotone Platt calibration on selected inner OOF
grouped_no_age: Keep grouped partitions; remove all eight phi age bins from latest, mean, variance and missing-fraction blocks: 122 -> 90 columns
grouped_no_od_readout: Keep OD-dependent grouped partitions; remove twelve OD phi columns in all four blocks: 122 -> 74 columns. OD still affects grouping.
fixed_no_od: Use archived time-only fixed partition family and remove OD readout/missingness blocks: 74 columns. Full-record canonicalization remains common upstream, so this is OD exclusion after canonicalization.
oracle_lineage_weight: Singleton-family design; change only mean/variance weights to w_j=sum_{i in window_j}1/multiplicity(i)/unique_visible_union_size. Latest, span, canonical message count and missingness stay unchanged. Not posterior fusion or effective sample size.
oracle_scope: Only audited observation IDs 0..59; IDs/condition names never enter predictor columns. Validate windows, order and publication availability. Reuse prior state reconstruction only under exact shared-input/source hashes.
canonicalization: Full allowlisted visible records first; feature removal second. Interventions condition on the same canonical prefixes; arbitrary raw OD changes could still affect upstream deduplication/tie order.
preprocessing: Columnwise train-only archived median/robust scaling; removed columns may remain in preprocessing state but cannot affect retained columns. Final readout scaler is refitted on retained design columns.
objective: One total unit per scenario across condition variants and partitions; folds keep all variants of each scenario together
selection: Minimum weighted clipped inner OOF log loss; tie toward smaller C; six candidates per arm, same budget as archived logistic controls
calibration: Selected inner OOF reused for tuning, monotone calibration and nominal 95% training-recall threshold; not independent certification
failure_policy: Any convergence warning, nonfinite output, incomplete grid, lineage/input incompatibility or failed invariant fails the run. Retain all completed fold checkpoints, OOF values, fit runtimes, solver iteration counts and failure category. New run ID for retry.
controls: Reuse 104 selected models / 13 arms only after data/source/fold compatibility audit; singleton removes grouping, fixed replaces OD grouping with time-only families
limitations: Bounded development implementations; grid maxima need an adequacy decision. No published-method reproduction, universal family ranking, real efficacy or scientific confirmation.
